entities.summary: Vila Praia de Âncora is a town and a civil parish in the municipality of Caminha in Portugal. It covers an area of 8.37 square kilometres (3.23 mi2) and had 4,623 residents as of 2021. Vila Praia de Âncora is the most populous town and parish in Caminha.
